sideChat.title: Side chat
sideChat.closeConfirmDescription: Unsaved messages and drafts will be cleared and cannot be recovered.
sideChat.temporaryDescription: Ends after 30 minutes without conversation. Save important content as a note. Ending a chat does not undo completed actions.
sideChat.emptyDescription: Ask without interrupting the main task.
sideChat.errorInvalidRequest: The side chat request is invalid.
sideChat.errorNotFound: This side chat is no longer available.
sideChat.errorConflict: This side chat is busy. Wait for the current response to finish.
sideChat.errorLimitReached: You already have 5 temporary chats. Close one to continue.
sideChat.stopCloseDescription: The current response will stop, and unsaved messages and drafts will be cleared. Completed actions will not be undone.
sideChat.expiring: This temporary chat will end in about {{minutes}} minutes.
sideChat.extendFailed: Could not extend this chat. Please retry.
sideChat.expiredDescription: This temporary chat ended after a period of inactivity. You can still copy or save content shown on this page.
sideChat.unavailableTitle: This temporary chat is no longer available
sideChat.unavailableDescription: You can start a new side chat using the parent task.
sideChat.waitExpired: This temporary chat ended while waiting for a response. You can still copy or save the content shown.
sideChat.replaceHint: Starting a new chat will replace this temporary chat.
sideChat.freshContext: Using the latest context from the parent task. The previous temporary conversation is not carried over.
sideChat.partialReading: Only recent content from this page is retained.
sideChat.draftTooLong: Message is too long. Please shorten it before sending.
sideChat.parentMissing: The parent task is no longer available.
sideChat.errorCapacity: Cannot create a chat right now. Please try again later.
